BARIN GHOSH, C.J. (Oral)
 The learned counsel for the appellant submits that there is
latent defect in the appeal and, accordingly, permission is being
sought to withdraw the appeal with liberty to file a fresh appeal after
removing the defect.
2. Such permission is granted. The appeal is dismissed as
withdrawn, with liberty as above.
